description: Project-authored deterministic mini tool/agent benchmark using runtime-neutral JSON actions and local mock tools.
system_prompt: You are an agent with local tools. On every turn output exactly one JSON object and nothing else. To call a tool use {"action":"tool","name":"TOOL_NAME","arguments":{...}}. If required information is missing, use {"action":"ask","field":"FIELD_NAME"}. When the task is complete, use {"action":"final","answer":VALUE}. Do not guess tool results. Do not use Markdown or explanations.

tasks.prompt: Use the available tools to get the current mock temperature for Rabat. In the final action, answer with only the numeric Celsius value.
Use the available tool to add 17 and 25. In the final action, answer with only the numeric result.
Look up order A104 with the available tool. In the final action, answer with only its status string.
Find the customer whose email is ada@example.test. Choose the correct lookup tool. In the final action, answer with only the customer ID.
Find the exact stock count for SKU P100. Choose the correct inventory tool. In the final action, answer with only the integer stock count.
Convert 20 USD to EUR using the most appropriate available tool. In the final action, answer with only the numeric converted amount.
The user says: 'What's the weather?' Use the available tool if possible, but do not invent missing information.
The user says: 'Check my order status.' Use the available tool if possible, but do not invent missing information.
Find the unit price of SKU P100, then use a calculator tool to compute the total for 3 units. Do not calculate the multiplication yourself. In the final action, answer with only the numeric total.
Find the customer ID for ada@example.test, then look up that customer's open orders. In the final action, answer with the order IDs as a JSON array in the same order returned by the tool.
